description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - a doorstep parcel sorter: look at each parcel one by one, wide-scan its label barcode as a record ID (no carrier lookup, no OCR - the recipient is declared by the wearer who read the label), pick recipient and content kind, flag urgency, and the parcel is committed to a spoken left-urgent / right-normal pile with a running piles summary
name: parcel-sort
